faq_heading: Abbotsford condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Abbotsford condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 429 of 510, or 84%. A further 76 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Abbotsford?
faq.a: $385,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $315,000 and $445,000.

faq.q: Which Abbotsford area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Abbotsford West, at $349,900 across 143 sales at $385 a square foot, median year built 1994. The highest of the 4 lowest was Abbotsford East at $456,000.

faq.q: How fast do Abbotsford condos sell?
faq.a: 35 days at the median, closing at 96.7% of the last list price, with 5% above list.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Abbotsford

In Abbotsford West the median condo sold for $349,900 across 143 sales, $250,100 under $600,000. Across Abbotsford the median condo took 35 days to sell and closed at 96.7% of the last list price, with 5% of the 510 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
